analysis.reasonEn: The sell decision has been maintained for the last 3 consecutive trading days. RSI, after entering oversold at 32.6, has slightly rebounded to 35.3 but remains in oversold territory. MACD histogram continues to worsen from -0.6839 to -1.9472. A Lower High pattern is confirmed as the 5-day high ($148.62) is below the 20-day high ($156.25). Trading volume ratio is 0.75, indicating subdued activity. The price is approaching the weekly SMA50 support at $130.42.
